text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-U.S. ambassador Jones conveys to President Hrawi and Prime Minister Hariri President Clinton's invitation to "the Conference of Lebanon's Friends".
-Parliament Speaker Berri: Some political parties are contacting the Israelis. I will demand that lawsuits be filed against them.
-The cabinet issue becomes a constitutional issue..What if Hrawi and Hariri insist on their positions. What would role of parliament be?
-Germany is ready to take back only "very polluted" plastic waste. Lebanon insists it should take back all 36 containers.
-Hizbollah MP Qassir: The environment does not encourage Hizbollah to enter the government.
-Electricity power cuts in Jbeil and Beirut.
-Israeli planes have been flying over south Lebanon for three continuous days.
-Economy Minister Jaber discussed with Iranian and Bulgarian delegations means of cooperating in fairs and exhibitions.
